# Vent Freeze Fix domain

## Overview
**Id:** blk-209beae2da1d

Vent Freeze Fix repairs a save/load bug with liquid vents. Super-cooled liquid in flight when a save is written comes back from the load as a natural tile, either inside the vent (entombing it) or in the cell under it (absorbing the vent's debris pile). The mod stops the first and undoes the second. It adds no buildings. The mod is `mods/vent-freeze-fix`, static ID `Isochronous.VentFreezeFix`, source in `src/VentFreezeFix/`.

## Key Entities
**Id:** blk-dc00673e5995

### Insulated vent storage (patch on LiquidVentConfig)
**Id:** blk-e2a2326c0ab7  
**Description**: Gives each liquid vent's `Storage` the game's insulated storage modifiers (hide, seal, insulate), so the packet a vent is about to emit is skipped by the phase-transition handler and not temperature simulated. This prevents the tile inside the vent.  
**Location**: `LiquidVentConfig_Storage_Patch` in `src/VentFreezeFix/Mod.cs`. Active when `Options.InsulateVents` is on; needs a restart.

### VentFreezeWatcher (component)
**Id:** blk-98e7ce8731de  
**Description**: Added to every liquid vent. For the first second of running time after it spawns (five 200 ms ticks) it watches the vent cell and the landing cell, remembers what each held the previous tick, and asks the sim to dig a tile that could not have formed in normal play. Then it removes itself from the scheduler. Implements `ISim200ms`.  
**Location**: `src/VentFreezeFix/VentFreezeWatcher.cs`

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| ventCell | int | The vent's cell, set in `OnSpawn` (`VentCell`) |
| ticks | int | Ticks run; the watcher stops after `ActiveTicks` = 5 |
| previous | Dictionary<int, Snapshot> | Element and mass each watched cell held the tick before |
| savedVentCell, savedVentElement, savedVentMass | saved | Vent-cell snapshot taken in `[OnSerializing]`, restored in `[OnDeserialized]` |
| savedLandingCell, savedLandingElement, savedLandingMass | saved | The same for the landing cell |
| RepairEnabled | static bool | The "Repair tiles after loading" option, set once per game |
| TileMassShare | const float | 0.8, the game's tile rule |

**Relationships**: reads `Grid.Element`, `Grid.Mass`, `Grid.Solid`, `Grid.Foundation`; files dig requests in `DigRequests`; the sim answers through the `WorldDamage.OnDigComplete` patch.

### DigRequests
**Id:** blk-5905b0e9316d  
**Description**: Static map of cells the watchers asked the sim to dig, and the patch that answers the sim's dig report for those cells by spawning the full mass as debris (a dug tile normally drops half). A request the sim ignores yields no report, so asking again is safe. Cleared on `Game.OnSpawn`.  
**Location**: `src/VentFreezeFix/DigRequests.cs`

### Options
**Id:** blk-63303acdea21  
**Description**: PLib options, shared config location.  
**Location**: `src/VentFreezeFix/Options.cs`

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| InsulateVents | bool | Default true, restart required |
| RepairOnLoad | bool | Default true, takes effect on the next load |
| DebugMode | bool | Default false, category Developer; verbose logging |
| ReproButton | bool | Default false, category Developer; adds the repro-save button |

### DebugSave
**Id:** blk-7391df44fb7c  
**Description**: Debug tooling. Reads the options once per game, logs vent emits in debug mode, and with the repro button arms a save that is written at the end of the frame in which a liquid vent next emits a packet, as `VentFreezeRepro.sav` next to the current save. That moment is the only one in which the bug's conditions can be captured.  
**Location**: `src/VentFreezeFix/DebugSave.cs`

### Harmony patches
**Id:** blk-138d9e285952  
**Location**: `src/VentFreezeFix/Mod.cs`, `src/VentFreezeFix/DigRequests.cs`, `src/VentFreezeFix/DebugSave.cs`

| Target | Kind | Purpose |
|--------|------|---------|
| `LiquidVentConfig.ConfigureBuildingTemplate` | Postfix | Sets the insulated storage modifiers |
| `LiquidVentConfig.DoPostConfigureComplete` | Postfix | Adds `VentFreezeWatcher` |
| `WorldDamage.OnDigComplete` | Prefix | Answers requested digs with full-mass debris; skips the original |
| `Game.OnSpawn` | Postfix | Two patches: clears `DigRequests`; reads the options and adds the repro button (in `DebugSave`) |
| `Exhaust.EmitCommon` | Prefix and Postfix | Debug: logs the packet and, if the repro button is armed, queues the save |
| `Game.LateUpdate` | Postfix | Debug: writes the queued save at the end of the frame and updates the button text |

### Saved state
**Id:** blk-75d011587898

Only the watcher's two cell snapshots, so the first comparison after a load has a "previous tick". The mod changes nothing else in the save.

## Business Rules
**Id:** blk-839fa2ca5de6

- The game forms a natural tile from a freezing liquid only when it holds at least 80% of the element's default mass; a one- or two-kilogram packet does not.
- A tile at the vent cell or landing cell is converted only when: the cell is solid, it is not a built foundation tile, an earlier-tick state exists, and the earlier state was not a liquid of at least 80% default mass ("formed from a real pool") and not already solid.
- A converted tile is dug through the sim and dropped as debris at the full mass the sim reports.
- The landing cell is the last open cell going down from the vent before the first solid (`LandingCell`). Cells still in the snapshot are also checked, since the walk down stops one cell higher once the landing cell turns solid.
- After the sim digs a cell, its snapshot resets to vacuum, so a tile that re-forms before the next tick is judged as new.
- A dig still pending with the cell still solid is asked again each tick.
- The watcher runs only in the first second of running time after a load, and does nothing at all when `RepairOnLoad` is off.
- The mod reads public grid data and uses the game's own dig path; it does not touch the sim otherwise.

## Domain Terminology
**Id:** blk-c479fbc0ae73

| Term | Definition |
|------|-----------|
| Packet | A small parcel of liquid mass moved through pipes; the vent stores one before emitting it |
| Natural tile | A solid cell of a natural element (not a built tile); what a freezing liquid becomes |
| Vent cell / landing cell | The vent's own cell / the last open cell under it |
| Snapshot | Element and mass of a watched cell at one tick (or at save time) |
| Verdict | The reason a cell is left alone, or null when its tile is converted (`Verdict`) |

## Key Code Paths
**Id:** blk-fdc3dcfd7c26

- **Install**: `LiquidVentConfig` postfixes add the insulated modifiers and the watcher. See `src/VentFreezeFix/Mod.cs`.
- **Save and load**: `[OnSerializing]` captures both cells; `[OnDeserialized]` -> `Restore` fills `previous`. See `src/VentFreezeFix/VentFreezeWatcher.cs`.
- **Repair**: `Sim200ms` -> `Check(cell)` -> `Verdict` -> `RequestDig` (`DigRequests.Add`, `SimMessages.Dig`) -> sim reports -> `WorldDamage.OnDigComplete` prefix -> debris spawned, `watcher.OnDug`. See `src/VentFreezeFix/VentFreezeWatcher.cs`, `src/VentFreezeFix/DigRequests.cs`.
- **Reproducing the bug**: repro button -> arm -> `Exhaust.EmitCommon` postfix -> `Game.LateUpdate` writes `VentFreezeRepro.sav`. See `src/VentFreezeFix/DebugSave.cs`.
- **Tests**: in-game `[OniTest]` suites in `src/VentFreezeFix.Tests/` (`Repair.cs`, `Storage.cs`, `ReproSave.cs`, `Kit.cs`).

## Related
**Id:** blk-75447c81c599

- See also: [glossary](glossary.md)

# Vent Freeze Fix glossary

Terms for the Vent Freeze Fix mod. For the mod's entities, rules and code paths see [entities](entities.md).

## Abbreviations and Acronyms
**Id:** blk-7e02fc6a16a9

| Abbreviation | Full Term | Context |
|--------------|-----------|---------|
| ONI | Oxygen Not Included | The game the mod is for |
| sim | The game's native simulation | Owns cell mass, temperature and phase changes; the mod asks it to dig |
| 200 ms tick | `ISim200ms` update | The watcher's schedule |
| PLib | Peter Han's mod library | Options screen |
| repro | Reproduction | The debug save (`VentFreezeRepro.sav`) that captures the bug's conditions |

## Terms to Avoid
**Id:** blk-10ea847ff6a2

| Avoid | Use Instead | Reason |
|-------|-------------|--------|
| Fix (for the tile conversion) | Repair | The option is "Repair tiles after loading"; "Insulate vent storage" is the prevention |

## Cross-Domain Terms
**Id:** blk-1697ed7ff0e5

### Liquid vent
**Id:** blk-e8a479abb601  
**Definition**: The vanilla building `LiquidVentConfig` that drips liquid from a pipe into a cell. The mod patches its prefab to add insulation and the watcher.  
**Used in**: `Mod.cs`.

### Super-cooled liquid
**Id:** blk-7dd126b0becf  
**Definition**: Liquid below its freezing point that has not frozen; small packets pushed through pipes can be in this state without breaking the pipe.  
**Used in**: `VentFreezeWatcher.cs`, mod description.

### Phase transition handler
**Id:** blk-4cd539c00174  
**Definition**: `SimTemperatureTransfer.DoOreMeltTransition`, the game's handler that converts an item past its phase transition into cell mass of the new phase with no mass rule. The cause of the tile inside the vent.  
**Used in**: comment on `LiquidVentConfig_Storage_Patch` in `Mod.cs`.

### Insulated storage modifiers
**Id:** blk-e1d60e038ed5  
**Definition**: `Storage.StandardInsulatedStorage`: hide, seal, insulate. Sealed items are skipped by the transition handler; insulated items are not temperature simulated.  
**Used in**: `Mod.cs`.

### 80% rule
**Id:** blk-dc6818cbd533  
**Definition**: The game forms a natural tile from freezing liquid only if it holds at least 80% of the element's default mass (`TileMassShare`).  
**Used in**: `VentFreezeWatcher.Verdict`.

### Dig
**Id:** blk-fca4205bc8e0  
**Definition**: The game's way of turning a natural tile into debris: `SimMessages.Dig` makes the sim remove the tile, then `WorldDamage.OnDigComplete` spawns what it removed (normally half the mass).  
**Used in**: `VentFreezeWatcher.RequestDig`, `DigRequests.cs`.

### Debris pile
**Id:** blk-b2d84a74cd66  
**Definition**: The loose items a vent's frozen packets leave on the floor; automation is often built on it. A tile forming in its cell absorbs it.  
**Used in**: README problem statement.

### Foundation tile
**Id:** blk-6c63c7a6f934  
**Definition**: A built tile (`Grid.Foundation`), as opposed to a natural one. The watcher never converts it.  
**Used in**: `VentFreezeWatcher.Verdict`.

## Related
**Id:** blk-4f4b397e2db2

- See also: [entities](entities.md)

# vent-freeze-fix

## What this is
**Id:** blk-50ab94beb967

Vent Freeze Fix is an Oxygen Not Included mod for a save/load bug with liquid vents. A save written while super-cooled liquid is in flight comes back from the load as a natural tile, either inside the vent (entombing it) or on the floor under it (taking the debris pile with it), because the game only applies its 80%-of-default-mass rule to tiles formed in running play. The mod insulates each liquid vent's storage so the packet it holds is not solidified, and for the first second after a load a watcher digs up any tile at or under a vent formed from less liquid than a tile needs, dropping it as debris at full mass. Both fixes are options, on by default; developer options add a reproduction button and debug logging. Version 0.2.0. Targets the current game with all DLC content (minimumSupportedBuild 744825).

## Where things are
**Id:** blk-9a8933671047

- `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`: player-facing description and release notes.
- `src/VentFreezeFix/`: the mod. `Mod.cs` (entry point and the vent storage patch), `VentFreezeWatcher.cs` (post-load watcher), `DigRequests.cs` (the dig answer), `Options.cs` (settings), `DebugSave.cs` (the save-on-next-vent-emit reproduction button), `ModStrings.cs` (UI strings), `mod.yaml` and `mod_info.yaml` (manifests).
- `src/VentFreezeFix/translations/`: `.pot` template and `ko`, `ru`, `zh` po files.
- `src/VentFreezeFix.Tests/`: in-game tests (storage, repair, repro save).
- `publish/`: Workshop description, tags, preview image (with its xcf source) and workshop id.

sections.title: What this is
sections.text:
## What this is
**Id:** blk-50ab94beb967

Vent Freeze Fix is an Oxygen Not Included mod for a save/load bug with liquid vents. A save written while super-cooled liquid is in flight comes back from the load as a natural tile, either inside the vent (entombing it) or on the floor under it (taking the debris pile with it), because the game only applies its 80%-of-default-mass rule to tiles formed in running play. The mod insulates each liquid vent's storage so the packet it holds is not solidified, and for the first second after a load a watcher digs up any tile at or under a vent formed from less liquid than a tile needs, dropping it as debris at full mass. Both fixes are options, on by default; developer options add a reproduction button and debug logging. Version 0.2.0. Targets the current game with all DLC content (minimumSupportedBuild 744825).

documents.text:
---
doc_id: doc-4a99769328fa
description: "C# code style for the Vent Freeze Fix mod: formatting, imports, comments, Harmony patch and game component conventions, plus a section on its vent patches, watcher component, developer options and option loading"
applies_to:
  - "src/**"
---

# Code Style Guide

## Formatting
**Id:** blk-755bac459824

### Indentation
**Id:** blk-d4231951840b

- Tabs, one per level, in every `.cs` file (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Project files (`.csproj`, `common/oni-mod.props`, `common/oni-mod.targets`) use two spaces.
- Files are committed with LF line endings; Windows checkouts convert them to CRLF (`core.autocrlf` is true), so do not hand-normalise line endings.

### Line Length
**Id:** blk-5f5635f26138

- No limit is configured and the repository has no `.editorconfig`.
- Wrap long calls and string concatenations after an argument or before a `+`, and indent the continuation one tab. The start-up log call in `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Mod.cs` is the pattern.
- TODO(owner): decide whether to add an `.editorconfig` recording tabs and brace placement so editors enforce what the code already does.

### Braces
**Id:** blk-d1be5334a770

- Opening brace on its own line (Allman) for namespaces, types, members and multi-line control blocks.
- A body of one short statement goes on the next line without braces:

```csharp
foreach (Mod mod in mods)
{
	if (!mod.IsEnabledForActiveDlc())
		continue;
	...
}
```

- Multi-line initialisers and enums end with a trailing comma (`YieldToWorkshopIds` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`, `CoolPodMode` in `mods/storage-pod-redux/src/StoragePodRedux/Options.cs`).

## Language and Toolchain
**Id:** blk-1911086a623a

- C# 9 on .NET Framework 4.8 (`LangVersion` 9.0 and `TargetFramework` net48 in `common/oni-mod.props`). Namespace blocks, not file-scoped namespaces; no nullable reference types.
- Mods compile against the game's own assemblies (`common/oni-mod.targets`): `Assembly-CSharp`, `Assembly-CSharp-firstpass`, `0Harmony` and Unity modules. The game's .NET Framework lacks some newer APIs (`ConditionalWeakTable.AddOrUpdate` is missing, see `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs`).
- Optional references are switched on in the mod csproj before the targets import: `ReferenceUnityUI`, `ReferenceImageConversion`, `UsePLib` (PLib is ILRepack-merged into the mod DLL) and `UseTranslations` (compiles `common/src/Translations.cs` in).
- One namespace per mod, equal to its `RootNamespace`. Subfolders organise files and do not add namespaces (`mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Plan`, `Rules`, `Tool`, `UI` all declare `namespace UpgradePlanner`).

## Imports/Includes
**Id:** blk-1e8dde3fbcd2

### Organization
**Id:** blk-eb77e2562806

`using` directives sit above the namespace, in one block with no blank lines, sorted alphabetically with `System.*` first. Aliases for `ModStrings` branches come last.

1. `System.*`
2. Everything else alphabetically: `HarmonyLib`, `Isochronous`, `KMod`, `Newtonsoft.Json`, `PeterHan.PLib.*`, `ProcGenGame`, `UnityEngine`
3. Aliases (`using TOOL = SweepZones.ModStrings.UI.TOOLS.SWEEPZONES;`)

### Example
**Id:** blk-0b8e3ef08773

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Reflection;
using HarmonyLib;
using Isochronous;
using Klei;
using KMod;
using STRINGS;
using UnityEngine;
```
(`mods/salty-surf/src/SaltySurf/Mod.cs`)

`Debug.Log` resolves either to `UnityEngine.Debug` or to the game's own global `Debug` class, so several `Mod.cs` files omit `using UnityEngine`. When a file imports `System.Diagnostics`, qualify the call as `UnityEngine.Debug.Log` (`mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`).

## Comments
**Id:** blk-ad1f807369ac

### When to Comment
**Id:** blk-430105ebb58b

- On every non-trivial class, an XML `<summary>` that says what the game does and what the patch changes, so a reader can check the patch against the game code. The long summary on `OvercrowdingMonitor_UpdateRegion_Patch` in `mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails/src/DontCountEggsOnRails/Mod.cs` is the model.
- Where a game quirk forces an odd line: `// The game's .NET Framework has no AddOrUpdate on this table.`
- Where another mod is involved, name it and its Workshop id (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`, `mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/Mod.cs`).
- Escape angle brackets in XML comments as `<` and `>`.

### When NOT to Comment
**Id:** blk-ce8e7e32e770

- Code that reads clearly from its names.
- Commented-out code; delete it.
- Restating what a line does.

### Format
**Id:** blk-2ec18495ab1b

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// The "Any" choice. It is a tag like the elements a sensor's Filterable holds, so it rides
/// in the same saved field and copies with the building's settings.
/// </summary>
public static class AnyElement

// Single-line note for a quirk or a reason.
```

## Control Structures
**Id:** blk-d228dc3c35c4

### Conditionals
**Id:** blk-456be1b4431d

Guard clauses and early `return` or `continue` keep nesting shallow (`SettleSimBackwalls.UpdateFromSim` in `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/SettleSimPatch.cs`):

```csharp
if (!Grid.IsValidCell(cell))
	continue;
ushort idx = data->backwallElement[cell];
if (idx == ushort.MaxValue || idx >= elements.Count)
	continue;
```

### Loops
**Id:** blk-1b40623f402c

- Plain `for` and `foreach`. Code that runs every sim tick or frame avoids LINQ and allocations; reuse scratch lists (`scratch` in `mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`).
- Local types are written out (`Tech tech = ...`). `var` appears mainly in `mods/upgrade-planner`, `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere` and the test projects; follow the surrounding file.

### Strings
**Id:** blk-0d4afc60efdf

- Log and UI text is built with `+` concatenation, or `string.Format` on a `LocString`. String interpolation is not used in mod code.
- Player-visible text is a `LocString` field in `ModStrings`, never a literal at the call site (see [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)).

## Harmony Patches
**Id:** blk-441857351745

- A patch is a static class with `[HarmonyPatch(typeof(Type), nameof(Type.Method))]`, or `[HarmonyPatch(typeof(Type), "PrivateMethod")]` for a non-public method, and methods named `Prefix`, `Postfix`, `Transpiler` or `Finalizer` (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`).
- Game state arrives through Harmony parameters: `__instance`, `__result`, `___field`. Fields read repeatedly use `AccessTools.FieldRefAccess` kept in a `static readonly` field (`mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs`).
- A prefix returns `true` to let the game's method run and `false` only when it replaces the method (`mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails`, `mods/bitshifter` `UpdateVisuals`).
- A patch that depends on an option implements `Prepare()` (`mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Patches.cs`); a patch with several targets implements `TargetMethods()`.
- `UserMod2.OnLoad` calls `base.OnLoad(harmony)`, which applies every patch in the assembly, then registers libraries and logs the version. A mod that must patch after all others applies its patches from `OnAllModsLoaded` instead (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Transpilers search for the instruction they change and report when it is not found; see [error handling](error-handling.md).

## Game Components
**Id:** blk-ed35ebb87372

- A component extends `KMonoBehaviour`, overrides `OnPrefabInit`, `OnSpawn` and `OnCleanUp` and calls `base` from each. Sibling components come in through `[MyCmpGet]` or `[MyCmpReq]` (`mods/no-magic-fridges/src/NoMagicFridges/FridgeThermostat.cs`).
- Saved state uses `[Serialize]` fields with `[SerializationConfig(MemberSerialization.OptIn)]` on the class (`mods/sweep-zones/src/SweepZones/ZoneStore.cs`).
- Components are added to prefabs from a `DoPostConfigureComplete` postfix with `go.AddOrGet<T>()`.

## Project-Specific Rules
**Id:** blk-eebace797a67

- Mod options are a PLib `POptions` class marked `[JsonObject(MemberSerialization.OptIn)]` and `[ConfigFile(SharedConfigLocation: true)]`, read through a static `Load()` (`mods/vent-freeze-fix/src/VentFreezeFix/Options.cs`) or through `SingletonOptions<Options>` (`mods/storage-pod-redux`). Option titles are string-table keys, so the translation follows the language.
- Every mod logs one line at load: `[<Name>] Loaded version <assembly version>`.
- Tests live in a separate `<Name>.Tests` project and are written as `[OniTest]` coroutines against the real game.

### Vent Freeze Fix specifics
**Id:** blk-f3f3abcc3239

- `UsePLib`, `UseTranslations` and `ReferenceUnityUI`. The two vent patches sit after the mod class in `Mod.cs`: `LiquidVentConfig_Storage_Patch` and `LiquidVentConfig_Patch`.
- `VentFreezeWatcher` is a `KMonoBehaviour` whose snapshot fields are `[Serialize]` and filled in an `[OnSerializing]` method, so a load has a "previous tick" to compare with.
- Options (`Options.cs`) include a Developer category with `DebugMode` and `ReproButton`; `DebugSave.cs` holds the debug save and the Debug mode patches, and `DigRequests.cs` the dig requests sent to the sim.
- Options are read with `Options.Load()`; `VentFreezeWatcher.RepairEnabled` is a static copy read once per game.

## Related
**Id:** blk-8ce27f44eace

- See also: [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)
- See also: [error handling](error-handling.md)
